Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at padma-bd.com and noticed you have a patient portal for report downloads (patient.padma-bd.com) and an online appointment form — that's ahead of most diagnostic centres in Bangladesh. But I also noticed the appointment form is a basic 'Send Request' with no instant confirmation, and your hotline (0961-1113355) runs 7am-11pm — meaning late-night and early-morning enquiries go unanswered.

With clients like Bangladesh Bank, MetLife, ACI, and Pathao on your roster, you're handling high-volume corporate health checkups. The Primary Health Checkup at ৳4,800 and the Major Health Checkup at ৳13,600 are the kind of packages that corporate HR teams want to book instantly — not wait for a callback.

I built an AI booking agent that handles appointment requests 24/7, confirms slots instantly, sends preparation instructions automatically, and notifies patients when reports are ready — so they stop calling your hotline to ask 'is my report done?'. For your corporate clients, it can bulk-book employee checkups and send automated reminders.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
